LanguageData.RimTalk_Knowledge_HelpContent:
【Knowledge Retrieval Logic】 The knowledge library automatically injects relevant knowledge during AI conversations:
1. Tag Matching: Extracts tags from conversation context and matches knowledge tags • Any Mode: Matches if any tag is found • All Mode: Matches only if all tags are found • ⚠️ Uses substring matching (case-insensitive)
2. Vector Similarity Matching (requires vector service): • Uses semantic similarity algorithms to find most relevant knowledge • Can find semantically related content even without exact tag matches
3. Importance Ranking: • Matched knowledge is sorted by importance (0.0-1.0) in descending order • Only top N most important entries are injected (configurable in settings)
【How to Write Effective Knowledge】
✓ Use comma-separated tags (recommended) • Good: [Lore,Ringworld] or [Rules,Dialog] • Good: [CharacterBackground,John] or [Event,Active,Raid] • Why: Commas are standard separators, clear and consistent
✓ Keep tags clear but avoid too short • Good: [Lore,PlanetSetting] (3+ chars) • Bad: [War] or [AI] (1-2 chars, prone to false matches) • Why: Short tags match too many unrelated contexts
✓ Use compound tags for precision • Good: [Lore,Ringworld,Technology] or [CharacterBackground,John,Past] • Bad: [John] (may trigger in unrelated conversations)
✓ Tags must be triggerable by conversations • Problem: Tag [Rules,CombatSystem] won't trigger in "shooting" "melee" conversations • Solution: Use [Combat,Shooting,Melee,Dodge] to add trigger tags • Or: [Rules,Combat,Shooting] keeps categorization while adding triggers
✓ Avoid using skill names as single tags • Problem: [Shooting] triggers in ALL conversations of pawns with Shooting skill (≥10) • Reason: Match text includes pawn's high-level skill names • Bad: [Shooting], [Melee], [Construction] (frequent false matches) • Good: [Rules,ShootingCombat,Aim], [Tips,Melee,Brawl] (requires explicit mention)
✓ Make content specific and actionable • Good: This planet is a ringworld with 0.8x Earth gravity • Bad: This planet is special
✓ Set appropriate importance levels • Core settings/rules: 0.8-1.0 • General background: 0.5-0.7 • Minor details: 0.3-0.5
✓ Use extended properties wisely • Can Be Matched: Enable to participate in tag/vector retrieval • Can Be Extracted: Enable for knowledge chain referencing
【Common Questions】 Q: Why is my knowledge injected too frequently? A: Tag might be too short or too broad. Use 3+ character compound tags like [Lore,ColonyHistory] instead of [History]
Q: Why isn't my knowledge being injected? A: Check if knowledge is enabled, matching mode is correct, importance isn't too low, and tags are relevant to conversation
Q: How to make AI use certain knowledge only in specific scenarios? A: Use precise compound tags (e.g., [Rules,Combat,RangedWeapons]) and moderate importance
